authority: User request 2026-11-06: a single click on an already selected text-capable object enters editing, including Shape/RichText/Sticky and Table cells. Preserve completed placement, 2x2 defaults and row fit changes.

owners.gesture: CanvasEditingRuntime normalized pointer acquisition and existing text tap recognizer

contract: First click on an unselected object selects it; a later single click on its body enters text editing on release, regardless of double-click timing.

Shape labels, standalone RichText, Sticky (including existing RichText child), and cells of a selected Table use their existing text target and caret mapping. Opening an empty editor makes no canonical operation.

Capture selection, semantic, camera, metrics, surface, scope and full pointer identity; reject changed/cancelled/retired candidates. Drag, resize, ports, Shift/multiple selection, lasso, image/crop, group scope, navigation and locks retain priority.
A browser double-click delivered after single-click entry must not finish/restart the active editor. Retain existing Group entry and Text-tool double-click behavior.

User correction 2026-11-06: Table cell changes select first, then a subsequent click on that same selected cell enters editing. Clicking another cell while editing finishes the old editor and selects the clicked cell only after immediate successful finish; pending/failed native composition does not switch cells.

For an otherwise eligible selected-object click, retain up to 4 logical pixels of pointer jitter without producing a Transform operation. Stationary clicks bypass drag snapping; real drag snapping remains unchanged.
